# path_history

The changesets that changed a file, or anything below a directory, newest first along first parents from main unless rev says otherwise, each with what the path holds after it (the CLI command is history); pass a limit of 100 or less and page on with the cursor, since clients limit long tool results.

```yaml
title: "path_history"
description: "List a path's history."
since: "0.1.0"
mutates: false
identity_required: false
cli_command: "swarmops history"
envelope_op: "path_history"
request_type: "PathHistoryReq"
annotations: {"destructiveHint":false,"idempotentHint":true,"openWorldHint":false,"readOnlyHint":true}
max_result_chars: null
```

## Input schema

`arguments` is a `PathHistoryReq`: `swarmops schema PathHistoryReq` prints the type. A field the type does not know is ignored.

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `cursor` | string or null | no |  | Resume a history: the previous page's `cursor`. Pass it back exactly as returned; do not construct it (cursors are opaque). This page continues from the first parent of the changeset it names, and `rev` is not used. |
| `limit` | integer | no | `50` | The most entries to return: at least 1 (0 is `E_INVALID_ARG`). |
| `path` | string | yes |  | The repository path: a file, whose history is that of its content and kind, or a directory, whose history is that of everything below it. One trailing `/` is taken. |
| `rev` | string or null | no |  | Where to start; `main` when omitted. |

          "type": "string"

## Annotations

It only reads the store.

| Annotation | Value | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `destructiveHint` | `false` | True: a tool that changes the store may overwrite or delete what is there, not only add to it. |
| `idempotentHint` | `true` | True: calling it again with the same arguments changes nothing more. |
| `openWorldHint` | `false` | True: it reaches beyond a closed set of things. Every tool here stays inside the store. |
| `readOnlyHint` | `true` | True: the tool does not change its environment, the store. |

Its entry in `tools/list` carries no `_meta`.

## CLI command

[`swarmops history`](../commands/history.md) runs the same operation and prints the same envelope.

## Examples

### MCP

```json
{
  "id": 15,
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "arguments": {
      "path": "src/lib.rs"
    },
    "name": "path_history"
  }
}
```

```json
{
  "id": 15,
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "result": {
    "content": [
      {
        "text": "{\"ok\":true,\"op\":\"path_history\",\"api\":1,\"result\":{\"path\":\"src/lib.rs\",\"entries\":[{\"changeset\":\"[landed]\",\"op\":\"put\",\"kind\":\"file\",\"id\":\"[id6]\",\"author_agent\":\"agent/worker-17\",\"created_at\":\"[created_at]\",\"title\":\"change f\"},{\"changeset\":\"[c1]\",\"op\":\"put\",\"kind\":\"file\",\"id\":\"[id7]\",\"author_agent\":\"agent/worker-17\",\"created_at\":\"[created_at]\",\"title\":\"first\"}],\"truncated\":false},\"meta\":{\"repo\":\"[tmp]/store\",\"elapsed_ms\":\"[elapsed_ms]\",\"resolved\":{\"main\":\"[landed]\"},\"auth\":\"trust\"}}",
        "type": "text"
      }
    ],
    "isError": false,
    "structuredContent": {
      "api": 1,
      "meta": {
        "auth": "trust",
        "elapsed_ms": "[elapsed_ms]",
        "repo": "[tmp]/store",
        "resolved": {
          "main": "[landed]"
        }
      },
      "ok": true,
      "op": "path_history",
      "result": {
        "entries": [
          {
            "author_agent": "agent/worker-17",
            "changeset": "[landed]",
            "created_at": "[created_at]",
            "id": "[id6]",
            "kind": "file",
            "op": "put",
            "title": "change f"
          },
          {
            "author_agent": "agent/worker-17",
            "changeset": "[c1]",
            "created_at": "[created_at]",
            "id": "[id7]",
            "kind": "file",
            "op": "put",
            "title": "first"
          }
        ],
        "path": "src/lib.rs",
        "truncated": false
      }
    }
  }
}
```

The server ran as `swarmops mcp --repo [tmp]/store --as agent/worker-17`, after `initialize`. Recorded by the MCP tests. A name in square brackets, such as `[tmp]` or `[c1]`, stands for what differs from run to run: the test's temporary directory, an id, a time, the version.

## Return information

A tool result: the envelope, whose `op` is `path_history`, as `structuredContent` and again as the text of its one `content` block. `isError` is true exactly when the envelope's `ok` is false. On success the envelope's `result` is what [`swarmops history`](../commands/history.md#return-information) returns.

## Errors

A failed call is a tool result with `isError: true`; the envelope's `error.code` is one of the [error codes](../errors.md).

- [`E_INVALID_ARG`](../errors.md#e_invalid_arg): arguments that do not fit `PathHistoryReq`, a field named twice among them included, or that break one of the server's own rules.
- [`E_NOT_A_REPO`](../errors.md#e_not_a_repo): the server's store is not there; the server serves on.
- [`E_INTERNAL`](../errors.md#e_internal): the operation panicked, a bug.

Then the errors of the operation, as [`swarmops history`](../commands/history.md#errors) lists them.
